name: OAuthClient
description: Represents an OAuth 2.0 / OIDC client registered with an identity provider that allows an application or service to obtain access tokens for an API.

client_id.description: Public identifier for the OAuth client issued by the identity provider.

client_name.description: Human-readable name of the OAuth client application.

client_type.description: Whether the client can keep a secret. Public clients (SPAs, native apps) cannot; confidential clients (server-side apps) can.

issuer.description: The OIDC issuer URL of the identity provider that issued this client registration.

grant_types.description: OAuth 2.0 grant types this client is permitted to use.

response_types.description: OAuth 2.0 response types this client is permitted to request.

redirect_uris.description: Allowed redirect URIs after authorization. Must be exact matches per OAuth 2.1.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes the client is allowed to request.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: How the client authenticates to the token endpoint. PKCE-only public clients use 'none'.

pkce_required.description: Whether PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) is required for this client.

access_token_lifetime_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds of access tokens issued to this client.

refresh_token_lifetime_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds of refresh tokens issued to this client.

audience.description: Identifiers of the APIs (resource servers) this client is allowed to obtain tokens for.

owner.description: Team or person responsible for this client.

status.description: Operational status of the OAuth client.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this client was registered.
